caption.dropped: Not sent. Too many messages were waiting.
composer.label: Message to {name}
composer.placeholderAway: {name} is away. Your message will wait here.
composer.placeholderNoPath: Your message will wait here until a path exists.
message.heldHint: Waiting on this device. Opens actions.
panel.noPath.title: Your two networks will not connect directly.
panel.noPath.body: This happens on some mobile and office networks. Your messages are safe on this device and will send as soon as a path exists.
panel.blocked.title: This connection did not pass its security check.
panel.blocked.body: Something between you and {name} changed the connection while it was being set up. ParolNet closed it. Nothing was sent.
error.generic: That did not work. Try again.
error.tooLong: That message is too long to send. Shorten it and send again.
error.notQueued: That message has already been sent.
error.storage: ParolNet could not save to this device. Free some space and try again.
call.needsLine: Calls need a direct line to {name}
call.ended.failed: The call could not connect. Check that you are both online, then call again.
call.error.media: ParolNet cannot use the microphone or camera. Allow them for this site in your browser, then call again.
call.error.notConnected: The line to {name} is not open yet. Try again in a moment.
call.error.busy: You are already in a call.
list.title: Conversations
list.unread: {n, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}
list.empty.title: No one here yet
list.empty.body: People are added with a code, not a phone number or a username. Add your first contact to start.
conversation.chooseBody: Messages go straight between your device and theirs.
conversation.noMessages: No messages yet. What you write stays on this device until {name}'s device takes it.
conversation.missing: This conversation is not on this device.
update.title: A new version is ready
update.body: Reload to use it. Nothing on this device changes.
boot.failed.core.title: ParolNet could not start.
boot.failed.core.body: The encryption part of the app did not load. Check your connection, then try again.
boot.failed.storage.title: This browser will not let ParolNet keep anything.
boot.failed.storage.body: ParolNet keeps your identity and your messages on this device. Private windows and some browser settings block that. Open ParolNet in a normal window, then try again.
firstRun.lead: Private calls and messages, straight from your device to theirs.
firstRun.body: No account, no phone number, no email. Nothing is stored on a server.
otherTab.title: ParolNet is open in another tab
otherTab.body: It runs in one tab at a time, so your messages stay in order.
otherTab.movedBody: You chose to use it there, so this tab stopped.
add.title: Add a contact
add.help: Keep this screen open while they add you.
add.qrLabel: Your code as a picture to scan
add.makeFailed: Your code could not be made. Try again.
add.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.
add.expiry: {minutes, plural, one {Good for # minute.} other {Good for # minutes.}} Works once.
add.ip: Contacts you add can see your IP address.
scan.title: Scan their code
scan.help: Point your camera at their code.
scan.notCode: That is not a ParolNet code.
scan.failed: The camera could not be started. Paste their code instead.
scan.denied: ParolNet cannot use the camera. Check your browser's permissions for this site.
scan.noCamera: No camera was found on this device. Paste their code instead.
paste.title: Paste their code
paste.label: Their code
paste.empty: Paste the code from your contact.
pair.invalid: That is not a complete ParolNet code. Ask them to copy the whole code again.
pair.expired: That code has expired. Ask them for a new one.
pair.failed: The contact could not be added. Try again.
name.title: Name this contact
name.bodyScan: You scanned their code in person, so this contact is verified.
name.bodyPaste: Their code was sent to you. Compare safety numbers with them when you can.
name.bodyTheyAdded: Someone used your code. Compare safety numbers with them when you can.
name.label: Name
name.promptTheirs: Someone used your code. Give them a name.
verify.title: Compare safety numbers
verify.body: Ask {name} to open this screen too, in person or on a call where you know their voice. Read the numbers to each other.
verify.unavailable: The safety number cannot be shown right now.
verify.mismatch.title: Do not trust this conversation yet
verify.mismatch.body: Different numbers mean your two devices are not connected only to each other. Someone may be in between, or the code was swapped when you added {name}. Remove this contact and add each other again, in person if you can.
details.title: Contact
details.verifiedInPerson: Verified in person: you scanned their code.
remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.body: This deletes the conversation and what is waiting to be sent, on this device. {name} is not told. To talk again, you add each other again.
sheet.blocked.title: What this means
sheet.blocked.body1: Before anything is sent, both devices check that they are connected to each other and not to something in between.
sheet.blocked.body2: This time the check failed, so ParolNet closed the connection. Your waiting messages are still on this device. Networks that inspect traffic can cause this. Try again, or try from another network.
notice.storage.title: ParolNet could not save to this device.
notice.storage.body: The device may be out of space, or the browser is blocking storage. Your last change may not be kept.
notice.turn.title: Your relay server cannot be reached.
notice.turn.body: “Use only this server” is on, so nothing connects without it. Check the server in settings.
install.hint: Install ParolNet to keep it at hand. Installed, its data is safer from the browser's clean-ups.
settings.title: Settings
settings.you.codeBody: Show or send your code to add a contact.
settings.wipe: Delete all data on this device
settings.wipe.body: This deletes your identity, your contacts and your messages from this device. It cannot be undone, and your contacts will have to add you again.
settings.wipe.label: Type “{word}” to confirm
settings.status.registered: Connected. Your contacts can reach you.
settings.turn.title: Relay through my own TURN server
settings.turn.body: Contacts you add can see your IP address. A relay server of your own hides it, and gives you a path when two networks will not connect directly.
settings.turn.passwordSaved: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
settings.turn.onlyHelp: Every connection goes through your server, so contacts see its address instead of yours.
settings.turn.removeFailed: Your relay server could not be removed. Try again.
settings.turn.invalid: Enter the address as turn:host:port, with the username and password of your server.
settings.relay.help: The server that helps your contacts find you. Leave this empty to use the one this app came from: {url}
settings.relay.invalid: The address must start with wss:// or ws://
settings.devices.speaker: Speaker
settings.devices.namesHelp: Devices have names here once you allow the camera and microphone.
settings.devices.speakerFixed: This browser chooses the speaker itself.
settings.notify: Notify me while ParolNet is open
settings.notify.help: ParolNet rings and receives only while it is open. A notification tells you when a message or a call arrives while you are in another tab.
settings.notify.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser.
settings.about.body: ParolNet sends messages and calls straight between devices, encrypted end to end. Messages stay on this device and wait here until the other person is online. ParolNet rings and receives only while it is open.
safety.label: Safety number
code.label: Your code as text
sheet.blocked.body3: This also happens after one of you restored an older backup. If it keeps failing, remove this contact and add each other again.
restored.note: {name} came back from a backup. If this conversation does not connect, add each other again.
panel.restored.title: This conversation no longer matches {name}'s device.
panel.restored.body: Your backup is older than your last conversation with {name}, so the two devices cannot read each other. Remove this contact and add each other again.
unlock.title: ParolNet is locked
unlock.label: Passphrase
unlock.forgot.body: A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered. You can delete everything on this device and start again. If you have a backup, you can restore it afterwards.
lock.wait: {seconds, plural, one {Too many wrong tries. Try again in # second.} other {Too many wrong tries. Try again in # seconds.}}
lock.hint: {n, plural, one {At least # character.} other {At least # characters.}} Several unrelated words are strong and easy to remember.
lock.forgotten: If you forget this passphrase, nobody can recover it, not even the people who make ParolNet. What is on this device is then lost, unless you have a backup.
lock.mismatch: The two passphrases are not the same.
lock.failed: The passphrase could not be changed. Nothing was changed. Try again.
settings.lock.title: Lock ParolNet with a passphrase
settings.lock.body: What ParolNet keeps on this device is encrypted, and the key stays in this browser. That does not stop someone who has your device and can open your browser. With a passphrase, ParolNet asks for it every time it starts, and without it nothing here can be read.
settings.lock.on: A passphrase is set. ParolNet asks for it every time it starts.
settings.lock.removeBody: Without a passphrase, ParolNet opens for anyone who can open this browser.
settings.backup.title: Back up this device
settings.backup.body: A backup is one file with your identity, your contacts and your settings, encrypted with a passphrase you choose. Keep it somewhere other than this device. Without one, losing this device loses your contacts.
settings.backup.never: No backup has been made on this device.
backup.historyHelp: Without it, the backup holds your contacts but not what you wrote to each other.
backup.forgotten: You need this passphrase to restore the backup. Nobody can recover it for you.
backup.twoDevices: Use a backup on one device at a time: two devices with the same identity keep cutting each other off.
backup.ready: Your backup is ready. Save the file and keep it safe.
backup.failed: The backup could not be made. Try again.
backup.hint: Make a backup, so that losing this device does not lose your contacts.
restore.title: Restore from a backup
settings.restore.body: Restoring replaces everything on this device with what is in the backup.
restore.replace: This replaces the identity, the contacts and the messages on this device with those in the backup. It cannot be undone.
restore.sessions: Your contacts come back as they were when the backup was made. If a conversation does not connect afterwards, add that contact again.
restore.error.notBackup: That file is not a ParolNet backup.
restore.error.newer: That backup was made by a newer version of ParolNet. Update the app, then try again.
restore.error.wrong: The passphrase is wrong, or the file is damaged.
restore.error.invalid: That backup cannot be used. What is inside it is incomplete.
restore.failed: The backup could not be restored. Nothing on this device was changed.
